title: Implement CLI commands for Milestone 1
description:
Wire up click commands in src/psp_etl/cli.py:
- psp-etl ingest <rom_path|directory> [--vendor NAME] [--model NAME]: parse ROMs, extract PSP entries
- psp-etl analyze [--reanalyze]: run string analysis on unanalyzed blobs
- psp-etl query [--gen] [--type] [--vendor] [--min-score] [--has-strings] [--format table|json|csv]: query DB
- psp-etl best [--gen] [--type] [--export-dir]: show/export best images
- psp-etl stats [--gen]: summary dashboard
- psp-etl select: recompute primary image selections
- Use rich for table output and progress bars
- Use click groups, not typer
- Depends on: db.py, ingest.py, strings.py

comments.author: driver
comments.content: Design decisions: (1) --data-dir is a click context param on the top-level group, default ./data. (2) Scrapers are sync (httpx.Client), no async. (3) All blob references in output must show human-readable labels (type_name+version), never raw hashes.
